about: core/loop_coverage.py (DEC-0101): every process MIA has, with a loop or a reason. status: todo (needs a loop), proposed (a task drafts it), none (why: no loop needed).

action:youtube.why: youtube.save keeps a link to a song he chose; which songs he likes is his taste, nothing of MIA's to improve

action:song.why: song.learned is him saying he can play a song; his own word, nothing of MIA's to improve

action:jars.why: jars.correct is him fixing a count he said wrong; his own word about his own batch

action:activity.why: turning noting on or off and erasing what was noted are his own choices about his privacy (DEC-0197); nothing of MIA's to improve in them

action:alarm.why: alarms set, switched and deleted by hand (Toolbox, DEC-0125): her own clock times, nothing of MIA's to improve

action:app.why: which apps show and which are favourites is their own choice; MIA judges nothing in it

action:art.why: deleting a picture MIA painted is the person's own choice (DEC-0140); nothing of MIA's to improve

action:browser.why: each held browser step is the person's own yes; one that fails counts in actions.failed, and taught tasks are watched by browser.runs

action:camera.why: removing a camera they added is their own choice; the feed itself is a device, not a decision of hers

action:capture.why: the person keeps or leaves out a recording (DEC-0125); a kept one is a journal entry, which has its own loop

action:closet.why: saving, wearing, rating and laundry are the person's own record; the ratings already change the suggestions in code (core/smart_closet.suggest)

action:closet_piece.why: adding and editing clothes is the person's own inventory; nothing of MIA's to judge

action:comms.why: the person's own settings for how often MIA speaks up (DEC-0129); the communication gate already learns from dismissals and logs every decision

action:connect.why: each import is the person's own ask, previewed and approved; a refused or failed one counts in actions.failed, and every import is undoable

action:connection.why: declining or allowing a connection is the person's own say (DEC-0146); connections.landed and connections.unlinked watch the connections themselves

action:conversation.why: deleting a past conversation, or saving one to Files, is the person's own choice; answers are watched by the ratings and turn-trace loops

action:direction.why: a direction is the person's own value in their own words (DEC-0141); the nudges it feeds are watched by checks.dismissed

action:energy.why: readings and sources entered by hand (Power, DEC-0125): measurements, not her choices; nothing of MIA's to improve

action:energy_source.why: readings and sources entered by hand (Power, DEC-0125): measurements, not her choices; nothing of MIA's to improve

action:firstboot.why: once per device; the glasses first boot is watched through glasses.voice once it is done

action:gps_track.why: keeping a GPX file someone chose and deleting one; the numbers are worked out in code from the file (core/gps_tracks.stats), so there's nothing to learn

action:history.why: history.undo puts back changes he names by time and subject (UI-3, core/change_history.py); the changes it reverses are MIA's own work, already watched by the loops of the actions and tools that made them

action:steps.why: steps.plan_week, do, change, drop and drop_plan are him working through a plan (UI-7); the change each step makes is its own action kind's, already watched there

action:shelf.why: shelf.keep, remove and clear are him putting things on his own shelf and taking them off (UI-4); there is no work of MIA's in them to improve

action:lab_reading.why: readings entered by hand in the Lab (DEC-0125): measurements, not her choices; nothing of MIA's to improve

action:listing.why: where a product is listed, entered by hand on the Workshop page or said (DEC-0125): the person's record, not MIA's choice; nothing of hers to improve

action:med.why: the person's medications as written on the label (DEC-0129); MIA never suggests a dose, so nothing to learn here

action:mission_idea.why: the person's yes or no on an idea MIA made (DEC-0125); the mission it becomes has the missions loop, and a set-aside idea is kept as history

action:notification.why: reading and dismissing notifications by hand; a dismissal already teaches the communication gate (its gate.* loops)

action:online.why: reminders kept by hand for when the internet is back and delivered all at once when it is; nothing there to get better at

action:path.why: drafting a learning path is a proposal the person approves; the path itself has its own loop (homework, checks and statistics in core/paths.py)

action:portal.why: which painting is in a portal is the person's own look (DEC-0140); paintings are watched with the art studio's

action:profile.why: their own settings: nothing MIA chose, so nothing of hers to correct

action:record.why: health records kept as given (DEC-0129); never interpreted

action:sensor.why: removing a sensor a person added; its readings are improved by each app's own reading loops (ranges, findings)

action:setting.why: their own settings: nothing MIA chose, so nothing of hers to correct

action:sleep.why: the person's own log of a night (DEC-0129); MIA reads it, never grades it

action:starter.why: a starter set added by the person from Settings or by voice (DEC-0125); what it adds are routines and upkeep, which have their own loops

action:style.why: a pick or a choice of how to be answered is the person's own taste (DEC-0138); the style it teaches is the loop (response_style learns from every pick)

action:taught_skill.why: teaching, changing and forgetting a skill is the person's own instruction; how well a skill runs is counted by the skill itself (clean runs, core/taught_skills._finish)

action:textbook.why: a course made from a book, or a book removed, by the person on the Classroom page or by voice (DEC-0125); the tutor's answers have their own loops

action:theme.why: a theme the person made or removed is their own taste (DEC-0136); nothing of MIA's to improve

action:track.why: deleting an uploaded song from the music library; nothing to learn from it (a song from the music folder itself is never deleted)

action:trail_map.why: taking a park map out is the person's own tidying; the map itself is the park's, nothing of MIA's to improve

action:undo.why: undo.last puts back the newest change, as "undo that" does; undoing MIA's own change already counts as a correction (core/corrections.py)

action:visit.why: visits as the person records them (DEC-0129); MIA never judges care

action:wallet.why: taking a card out of the wallet is the person's own choice; nothing of MIA's to improve

action:weather.why: which town the weather is for is the person's own choice (DEC-0153); the forecast is Open-Meteo's, nothing of MIA's to improve

action:why.why: the person's own reasons, linked, unlinked or marked achieved by hand on My Why (DEC-0125); MIA never invents a reason, so there's nothing of hers to improve

action:world.why: worlds, campaigns and quests are the person's own fiction (DEC-0134, DEC-0137); nothing real to improve

action:library.why: fetching offline packs is his choice on a card; each download is checked against Kiwix's hash and its outcome told, with no judgement of MIA's in it to improve (what her look-ups miss is for the library to learn from: T-0060)

action:model.why: removing or fetching one of her models (REQ-HW-014) is his choice on a card, done by the model server; the outcome is the server's and is told, with no judgement of MIA's in it to improve

action:system.why: the system helper's three operations (FW-06) each need his yes on the card and his password in the OS's dialog; whether one was done is the helper's journal and the action's own record, with no judgement of MIA's in it to improve

check:restore_drill.why: the monthly restore drill (WP-09) passes or fails on what the backup holds: a failure is told at once and kept as backup.drill on the Backups screen; there is no judgement of MIA's in it to improve

check:auto_backup.why: the nightly backup either is made or is not: a failed night is kept as backup.auto_problem, shown on the Backups screen and logged, and tried again the next night; there is no judgement of MIA's in it to improve

check:self_changes.why: the daily summary only reports what went in on Claude's pass (core/self_merges.py, DEC-0225); whether her changes were good is measured where they are made: Night School's grades, the dev ledger and his Undo

check:birthday.why: a greeting once a year: there is nothing in how it lands to learn from

check:chronicle_issue.why: Zac approves every issue by hand, and its continuity rules are checked in code before he sees it

check:fix_report.why: it writes the fix report for Claude; the failures it lists are watched by answers.failures

check:rewards.why: it unlocks what the person already earned by rules they can see; it judges nothing of its own

check:seasons_of_memory.why: it keeps a summary of the history once a month; what it says is answered through the seasons plan, watched by the answers.* loops and calibration like every plan

check:self_report.why: it reports the loops: what it says is only as good as they are, and they are watched

check:system_map.why: The daily system-map regen is itself the loop that keeps MIA_MAP.md current; it reads state and rewrites the doc, nothing to watch over it.

store:recall.why: derived from his stores and rebuilt from them (core/recall_index.py, DEC-0210): it holds refs and vectors only, never a record, so there is nothing in it to improve apart from the stores it follows

store:activity.why: names and window titles noted for him (core/activity_watch.py, DEC-0197); what MIA does with them, the offers she makes, is measured by the communication gate's own pacing and its loops

store:art.why: the pictures MIA painted on request and what from (DEC-0140); what she paints is the person's taste, and a failed painting is told at once

store:closet.why: a loop counting suggestions worn against skipped, to tune the weights in core/smart_closet.suggest (DEC-0162)

store:data_logger.why: readings from meters and sensors: measurements, not her choices (grow_alert speaks when one is out of range)

store:direction.why: Its active-encouragement loop is check:direction_nudge (DEC-0141), which paces the gentle nudges through the gate; the store itself just holds the standing directions a person set.

store:energy.why: readings from meters and sensors: measurements, not her choices (grow_alert speaks when one is out of range)

store:gps_tracks.why: where a person went, from their own GPX files: no MIA behaviour in it to improve yet; its numbers are worked out in code and tested

store:health.why: the person's own health records as they give them (DEC-0129); MIA never grades or interprets them, so there's no work of hers to improve

store:homestead.why: only its setup writes it so far; a loop comes with the first app or action that does

store:id_wallet.why: the person's own cards as they give them; MIA reminds before expiry and never reads or uses the numbers

store:intents.why: their reasons in their own words; MIA keeps them and never judges them

store:life_events.why: the history beside the stores, never rewritten; what lands in it is judged by the loops of the stores that write it

store:links.why: how things relate, stated by people or derived from records: as good as the records, which have their own loops

store:lite_captures.why: their own notes and scripts, kept as they wrote them: MIA writes none of it

store:living_worlds.why: the person's own fiction (DEC-0134); fictional events never count as real life (DEC-0137)

store:net_worth.why: a reading of net worth once a day, worked out in code from the accounts and properties: a measurement, not her choices

store:online_reminders.why: a list they asked for, delivered whole the moment the connection returns: nothing is chosen or timed, so nothing to learn from

store:personal_life_events.why: the history beside the stores, never rewritten; what lands in it is judged by the loops of the stores that write it

store:project_plans.why: drafts he works out with her and confirms himself; the missions it makes are watched as missions, and a build or crop she can't plan is said to him (a calculator or job not written yet is a trades.depth gap)

store:plans.why: a shelf of references the household keeps; a structure she can't work out a material list for is logged as no_tool and watched by gaps.repeated

store:response_style.why: This store IS a self-improvement loop by construction (DEC-0138): it runs A/B style experiments, records which the person preferred, and adapts phrasing. Nothing outside it needs to watch it.

store:runs.why: a record of other engines' runs (UI-1, DEC-0188): how well each engine's runs go is measured by that engine's own loop (browser.routines, the skills' practice, workflows' runs); this store judges nothing

store:step_plans.why: a plan is a list of other apps' actions lined up for him (UI-7); how well each of those goes is measured by that action's own loop, and a plan is also a run (store:runs)

store:shelf.why: a short-lived holding place for what he sent (UI-4, Q-43); it judges nothing, and what he does with an entry is an action already watched by that action's own loop

store:scripts.why: their own notes and scripts, kept as they wrote them: MIA writes none of it

store:taught_skills.why: a loop over each skill's runs: clean against stopped and declined, to notice a skill that keeps failing or a step that's always refused, and offer to fix it (DEC-0123, phase 2)

store:textbooks.why: the books and chapters they added; the tutor keeps no quiz answers to grade, so there is nothing to measure until it records them

action:world_watch.why: adding, pausing and removing watches is the person's own choice of what to look for; the finds' loop judges the watches by what they find

action:world_find.why: saving a find or setting it aside is the person's judgement; it already feeds the gate's learned pace for World Intelligence's messages (DEC-0171)

action:world_intel.why: on or off is the person's switch (DEC-0053: switching it on is the asking)

action:world_source.why: muting a source is the person's choice; the world.sources loop already judges each source and suggests what to mute

store:requirements.why: a loop over needs: how long lines stay open, how many are found by World Intelligence before bought elsewhere, and needs nobody updates (P3, DEC-0172)

action:requirement.why: adding, changing and ticking off needs is the person's own list; the needs loop (todo) judges the list itself

store:prices.why: a loop over price observations: how old the latest price for each open need is, and lows missed (P3, DEC-0172)

action:price.why: a price recorded or a trip cost set is the person's own record; the prices loop (todo) judges what's kept

action:grant.why: taking a grant back is the person's own decision about what MIA may do alone; nothing to improve by measuring it

store:teamwork.why: a project's workspace and team records (T2): it judges nothing itself; how good the specialists' entries are is measured from confirmations and withdrawals when teams run (T7's loop)

action:teamwork.why: teamwork.note, confirm and withdraw are him writing and judging entries in his own project's workspace (T2); his confirmations and withdrawals are what T7's loop will learn from

action:team.why: team.propose, start and stop are records of a team he says yes to (Q-54); nothing runs in a team until T3, whose run gets its loop

action:learned.why: forgetting a habit she learned is the person's own decision about what she learned; the habits themselves are loops already (the gate's pace, answer style)

check:update_waiting.why: says once, through the gate, that an MIA OS update is staged for his restart (Q-114); a fact about the machine, paced by the gate like every message: no judgement of MIA's in it to improve

check:weather_watch.why: the forecast against his garden plans and flock, worked out in code from fixed thresholds (frost advisory, hard freeze, heat); each message paced by the gate, whose pacing already learns from what he opens or dismisses

check:unusual.why: each finding is worked out in code from his own records against their own normal; what it says is paced by the gate, whose pacing learns from what he opens or dismisses (the topic 'unusual')

check:garden_week.why: his garden plans' own dates, worked out in code from his frost dates and said once a week; the gate's pacing already learns from what he opens or dismisses (topic garden_week)

check:market_eve.why: his market days and goods, with how much to bring worked out in code from his own closed markets (core/goods.demand, already a figure that learns from each market); said once per market day, paced by the gate

check:evening_wrap.why: his own records said once an evening; the gate's pacing learns from whether he opens or dismisses it (topic evening_wrap), and he can mute it from the message

check:habit_offer.why: each habit is offered once ever and never again (his rule, DEC-0294), so there's no repeated judgement to improve; the gate paces the one message

action:hatch.why: it makes one mission from fixed incubation days (core/hatch_tracker.BIRDS); the mission's steps are his to tick, and the missions' own loops judge how missions go; no judgement of MIA's here to improve

action:broilers.why: it makes one mission from fixed meat-breed weeks (core/broiler_batch.BREEDS); the steps are his to tick and the missions' own loops judge how missions go; no judgement of MIA's here to improve
